question: What family solve-status and cost boundaries appear in the internally consistent 477-row Phase-C source at one commit and 20-second budget?
nonDuplication: ETT-025 showed pooling sources is invalid. Phase-C is the largest single-source cohort and supplies a fixed commit/budget across 11 parent families, so it can be analyzed without selecting among repeated rows.

sampleSelection.rule: all and only ETT-025 rows whose sourceFile is reports/stress/phase-c-family-variant-results.json

control: logs/stress-corpus2-baseline.json historical canonical baseline; observational only
primaryOutcome: parent-family solve disagreement and variant solve rates
stoppingRule: one source-preserving boundary report; no cross-source pooling and no solving
escalationRule: nominate cold current-main retests only for parent-clustered cliffs with complete joins; do not infer current capability from historical Phase-C outcomes
